angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 203,840 km at 20.56 pc = 0.13 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 48.6414 +/- 0.0146 mas (same row, RUWE 1.16): 20.56 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.293 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Lee et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6324 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...983L..36L/abstract): 203,840 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.269 +/- 0.012 solar masses from Lee et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-6324 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...983L..36L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3247 +/- 70 K from Lee et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6324 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...983L..36L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lee et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6324 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...983L..36L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-6324.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.934, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6324 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.32 dex, from Lee et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...983L..36L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6324 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.99802, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/ApJ/821/93/table1 (Rotation & Galactic kinematics of mid M dwarfs), column Per: 1.007 d, the row 0.8 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.293 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.136. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
